Summary: inbound SMB lead focused on high-volume marketing generation (newsletters, landing pages, SEO clusters). Wants hosted, self-serve flow. Very cost sensitive; primary evaluation metric = cost per 1M tokens and ability to reduce unit cost via batching + prefix/KV caching.

CRM Notes (shorthand):
- Product: VerdantText is a content platform for small publishers and agencies (11-50 ppl). High volume: 500-2,000 completions/day for templates (email, blog intros, meta descriptions).
- Pain: current provider expensive on variable-length templates. "We get a lot of short completions and a few long ones — cost spikes are unpredictable."
- Wants: hosted API, easy self-serve onboarding, token-level cost visibility, streaming for editor UX. Interested in automatic prefix caching for repeated templates and advice on batching for bursts.
- Latency/throughput: target p95 < 400ms for short completions (<64 tokens), can accept higher for long-form (<=2s). Throughput target ~50-150 req/s during marketing sends.
- Model prefs: flexible to use smaller open models (quantized) if quality ok; wants fallback routing to higher-capacity models for long-form only.
- Security: SOC2 ok as baseline, needs audit logs, optional KMS for API keys (ask: can Redwood hosted support customer-managed keys later?).
- Billing: looking for predictable monthly banding vs pure per-token; asked about burst protection and quotas for self-serve.

Direct quotes: "We need predictable unit economics — tell us where we can shave tokens without breaking voice." / "Can we cache the first 40 tokens of our templates? That would save us a ton."

Linked artifacts: drive pricing deck, demo recording id (ff-20260304-verdant-demo-001), gmail thread for billing questions.
